#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <sstream>
#include <vector>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::string s;
    
    std::cin >> n;
    std::cin >> s;
    
    int maxLen = 0;
    int countOutside = 0;
    int currentLen = 0;
    bool inside = false;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
        char c = s[i];
        switch (c) {
            case '(':
                maxLen = std::max(maxLen, currentLen);
                currentLen = 0;
                inside = true;
                break;
            case ')':
                if (currentLen > 0) countOutside++;
                currentLen = 0;
                inside = false;
                break;
            case '_':
                if (inside) {
                    if (currentLen > 0) countOutside++;
                } else {
                    maxLen = std::max(maxLen, currentLen);
                }
                currentLen = 0;
                break;
            default:
                currentLen++;
        }
    }
    maxLen = std::max(maxLen, currentLen);
    std::cout << maxLen << " " << countOutside << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
